title: Charged Up? Impacts of Green Energy Transition on Local Labor Markets
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper studies the effects of utility-scale renewable energy expansion on local labor markets in the United States from 2005 to 2019. Utilizing exogenous solar and wind potentials from remote sensing data, we find a positive employment effect from solar and wind energy, and the effects are not short-lived. Solar energy also contributes to small wage growth. We find notable increases in jobs and business establishments in many sectors, particularly manufacturing in support of a local agglomeration effect. These gains are very localized, reflected in strong in-migration and weak local spillover. The gains are mostly concentrated among younger and lower-educated workers.
abstract_zh: 本文研究2005至2019年间美国大型可再生能源扩张对地方劳动力市场的影响。利用遥感数据构造的外生太阳能和风能潜力，我们发现太阳能和风能带来了正向的就业效应，且这一效应并非昙花一现。太阳能还带来了小幅的工资增长。我们发现，在许多行业中，尤其是为配套本地产业集聚效应而发展的制造业，就业岗位和商业机构显著增加。这些收益高度局部化，表现为强劲的迁入和较弱的本地溢出效应。收益主要集中于年轻及受教育程度较低的劳动者。

title: When Do Climate Provisions and Industrial Policy Goals Align? An Analysis of the US EV Market
How Much Do Consumers Value Fuel Economy and Performance? Evidence from Technology Adoption
venue: The Review of Economics and Statistics
abstract: During historical periods in which U.S. fuel economy standards were unchanging, automakers increased performance but not fuel economy, contrasting with recent periods of tightening standards and rising fuel economy. This paper evaluates the welfare consequences of automakers forgoing performance increases to raise fuel economy as standards have tightened since 2012. Using a unique data set and a novel approach to account for fuel economy and performance endogeneity, we find undervaluation of fuel cost savings and high valuation of performance. Welfare costs of forgone performance approximately equal expected fuel savings benefits, suggesting approximately zero net private consumer benefit from tightened standards.
abstract_zh: 在美国燃油经济性标准保持不变的历史时期，汽车制造商提高了车辆性能，但并未提高燃油经济性；与此形成对比的是，2012年以来标准趋严、燃油经济性随之提高的时期。本文评估了自2012年标准趋严以来，汽车制造商放弃性能提升、转而提高燃油经济性所带来的福利后果。利用一个独特的数据集，并采用一种新颖的方法来处理燃油经济性与性能之间的内生性，我们发现消费者低估了燃油成本节约，同时高估了性能。放弃性能的福利损失大致等于预期的燃油节约收益，这表明标准趋严带来的私人消费者净收益近似为零。

title: The Effects of Fuel Prices and Vehicle Sales on Fuel-Saving Technology Adoption in Passenger Vehicles
abstract: Although economic theory suggests that both sales and fuel costs affect technology adoption by vehicle manufacturers, there is very little empirical evidence on either effect. We document a strong connection between a vehicle's sales and its energy efficiency. Using a demographics‐driven demand shifter to isolate demand‐side changes in sales, we find that a one standard deviation increase in sales raises efficiency by 0.2%, compared with a mean improvement rate of 1.4% per year between 1997 and 2013. Higher fuel prices also increase technology adoption directly by increasing willingness to pay for fuel cost savings. The results have two implications: manufacturers will continue to focus technological improvements on top selling vehicles; and fuel taxes will have larger effects on technology adoption than fuel economy standards and feebates.
abstract_zh: 尽管经济理论认为，销量和燃油成本都会影响汽车制造商的技术采用，但关于这两种效应的实证证据却非常有限。我们记录了汽车销量与其能效之间的紧密联系。利用一个由人口结构驱动的需求移动变量来分离需求侧的销量变化，我们发现销量每增加一个标准差，能效提高0.2%，而1997至2013年间的平均年改进率为1.4%。更高的燃油价格也会直接促进技术采用，因为它提高了消费者为节省燃油成本而愿意支付的价格。研究结果有两点启示：一是制造商将持续把技术改进集中于畅销车型；二是燃油税对技术采用的影响将大于燃油经济性标准和补贴—收费（feebate）制度。
